hypothesis: Answer-only QLoRA on explicitly constructed examples can reduce empty act proposals and unsupported acts while retaining source attribution.

evaluation.untouchedComparison: Identical downloaded MLX quantization and runtime with/without adapter, same task/schema/prompt and greedy decoding
evaluation.selection: Use final 120-step adapter only; no choosing by locked test performance. Validation loss is diagnostic.
evaluation.testAccess: Create and hash corpus before training; run final test once per untouched/adapter variant.
evaluation.researchGate: At least 20/24 locked-test full act sets correct, >=4 additional matches vs untouched, no copied/injection false report, and no loss on the small unrelated control set. A failed gate stays isolated.
evaluation.promotion: No automatic deployment: agent-authored labels and tiny controls are not independent validation; Ollama equivalence and work-12 remain unproven.

privacy: Invented recipes only, never private archives, no online telemetry or model uploads. Base model read-only by convention; adapters saved separately.
